name: specter-crew
description: A squad of Exorcist agents that investigate every production ghost in parallel and return one incident report.
author: DrunkTrader
useCases: When three services misbehave at once, ask exorcism-lead to hunt every ghost in parallel and read one ranked incident report
When a ghost-hunter finds a root cause, read its cited trace IDs and its Kiro fix spec before approving a PR
When an incident feels familiar, let the squad check Specter's incident memory before it investigates
